scope: Job discovery, user-owned LinkedIn intake, profile matching, market-demand intelligence, pointer telemetry, repository evidence and isolated auditing, and interchangeable local/API LLM transport.

desktop_manual_intake.summary: Added a Tk desktop form for user-pasted job descriptions. It creates normal applications with source metadata, queues market-demand extraction through the existing trigger, supports free screening, and offers explicit opt-in progression through LLM/document stages. It has no browser, CDP, LinkedIn login, cursor injection, or application-submission capability.

project_profile_registry.summary: Added a private local Python/Tk project-profile form and JSON source of truth for the six existing Word resume blocks. It records template identity, aliases, skills, technologies, JD keywords, evidence locations, allowed facts, and do-not-overclaim boundaries. Parsed/aggregated records map only through user-confirmed aliases; ties and unknown records remain unmapped. Resume generation now reads those aliases to bind an approved profile asset to its correct immutable project block.

resume_template_pdf.summary: A template-preserving renderer limits tailoring to the existing 12 project bullet slots, five skill rows, and six audited header subtitles of the supplied one-page Word resume. It hard-enforces six fixed project blocks, immutable project name/date/GitHub fields, per-slot two-line/one-line character budgets, primary-before-secondary pairing, evidence-backed ranked skill rows, a project-slot-to-approved-asset binding, and literal JD/project-evidence change logs for both project bullets and subtitles. The verifier independently rejects unsupported resume changes before DOCX export. Cover-letter prompting and validation now require literal candidate/JD evidence and, where research exists, a candidate-asset-backed, URL-backed company-specific paragraph with a literal quote from the sourced company context rather than generic company praise. It runs only after claim QA passes and writes a local DOCX for Word-based review/Print to PDF; JobOS intentionally does not use LibreOffice to make the final PDF because that engine paginated the source template differently.

code_change_notes.summary: Added one local-Ollama/OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Generation, chat, and embedding callers use the same global or per-role backend switch; explicit DeepSeek URL-style support prevents an incorrect /v1 suffix, and the embed role fails clearly if configured with that text-only route. Tokens remain environment-only.

Added approved-profile search terms, transparent ranking, and a dedicated JobOS LinkedIn browser profile. The native browser launcher creates a loopback-CDP Chrome profile that the user signs into manually once; no password/cookie transfer occurs. A user-created, bounded discovery task can search supplied terms, read at most five job-detail pages, validate structured JD output, and auto-ingest it into applications. It cannot authenticate, solve CAPTCHA, save jobs, set alerts, change preferences, message, fill forms, or submit.

Added consented local pointer telemetry and rolling Theil-Sen drift plus MAD diffusion estimates. Output keeps multiple time-ordered regimes and raw drift samples; it has no cursor playback or automation capability.

Replaced the static technical-term extractor with an LLM-first queued pipeline. A database trigger queues every captured JD before filtering, including filtered_out and fit_rejected jobs; the worker maps long JDs by chunk and persists a requirement only when its LLM-provided quote is found verbatim in the source. Queue state, attempts, backend/model metadata, and failures are inspectable and retryable; requirements aggregate by fit role_family or normalized job title for early-discarded jobs. An opt-in Compose profile provides a retrying, read-only source-mounted worker once an LLM route is configured.

Added read-only GitHub inventory, an isolated offline audit worker, and a separate repository-evidence store. GitHub metadata and test reports require ownership confirmation and a second human asset approval before document generation can use them.

Fixed the dead-letter error-column mapping, added queue-wide allowed-domain enforcement, and configured the Chrome sidecar with an explicit CDP port. Browser execution still depends on a reachable OpenClaw gateway and a running sidecar.

Added a read-only end-to-end preflight that explains profile-context, schema, LLM, job, allow-list, and optional browser gates. Added a deterministic profile brief/context-pack builder that runs only after human-approved assets and capabilities; it never auto-approves evidence.

Added non-interactive OpenClaw setup for native or Docker mode. It generates a private gateway token when missing, renders four isolated agent workspaces, correct CDP network endpoints, optional-provider gating, and a deny policy for process/filesystem mutation. The private launcher pins JobOS to its tested Node 24/OpenClaw runtime instead of a global Homebrew installation. Provider keys are staged only in the untracked runtime .env when the operator supplies them.

Added an Ubuntu NVIDIA/Ollama runbook, a non-mutating GPU doctor, and an optional Docker GPU overlay. The documentation distinguishes an Ubuntu GPU compute host from a non-GPU ThinkPad capture/client and documents an SSH-tunnel path to a separate Windows/Linux GPU workstation, so unauthenticated Ollama is never exposed directly to a LAN or Internet address.

Replaced unsafe universal work-authorization/sponsorship defaults with a user-confirmed semantic immigration profile. Every captured JD now receives a pre-filter explicit-policy assessment. The ledger separates JD policy, E-Verify evidence, and H-1B history, preserving source evidence without inferring that E-Verify means sponsorship. Immigration question matching is fail-closed and routes every such form question to human review.

Disabled the LLM-driven real-form write path. New approval data binds one application, document hash, target action, and origin for a future deterministic engine, while legacy unbound approvals fail closed. The direct planner refuses writes until active-origin and state-aware radio/checkbox verification exist. Cover-letter structure is deterministic; all substantive paragraphs require candidate evidence, company claims require source-quote entailment verification, and a partially failing resume is regenerated instead of flattened into a template-breaking revision.

Added a one-command Ubuntu 24 bootstrap that creates an untracked local environment, installs root requirements including psycopg, starts only PostgreSQL, waits for readiness, and applies checksum-tracked migrations without starting models, OpenClaw, or paid workers. Employer evidence is append-only and shared across a company's applications. Immigration synthesis now emits HIGH only for a confirmed profile plus verified E-Verify and positive H-1B history; citizenship, US-person, permanent-authorization, and sponsorship restrictions remain semantically separate.

Added transport-neutral deterministic autofill contracts: inspect fields, map exact static values, pause derived/sensitive/unknown values, emit least-privilege per-field commands, and require post-write verification before completed status. OpenClaw, Playwright, and CDP are adapter choices; no adapter receives a full candidate profile or authority to decide form answers.

decision_log.decision: Allow only a user-created, bounded discovery task against the manually authorized dedicated LinkedIn profile; no automated login, cursor simulation, or application submission.
decision_log.reason: Keeps intake auditable while allowing the JobOS browser executor to collect a small, explicit set of full JDs.

decision_log.decision: Use only approved capability names, tool tags, competency tags, and role families to generate terms and rank captured jobs.
decision_log.reason: Avoids treating draft profile data as candidate evidence.

decision_log.decision: Record local consented telemetry and estimate time-varying regimes with Theil-Sen drift and MAD diffusion. No global mean and no playback capability.
decision_log.reason: Preserves local variation while preventing browser-evasion automation.

decision_log.decision: GitHub inventory is read-only; tests run in an unprivileged offline container; the coordinator reads structured reports rather than hidden reasoning.
decision_log.reason: Limits supply-chain and host-execution risk while retaining traceable findings.

decision_log.topic: Repository facts in the candidate profile
decision_log.decision: Store GitHub metadata, audit outputs, and explicit user ownership confirmation in repository_evidence_* tables, separate from profile chunks. Compile them to a needs-review project asset; only a later explicit asset approval makes the evidence eligible for L6 documents.
decision_log.reason: A repository can show metadata and test output but cannot establish authorship, employment, impact, or implementation responsibility by itself.

decision_log.decision: Queue every captured JD independent of filter/fit outcome. Use an LLM to identify explicit tools, skills, methods, standards, qualifications, and responsibilities without a static technology allowlist; save only model items whose quoted evidence is located in the original JD. Project ideas start as reviewable proposed backlog entries.
decision_log.reason: Keeps poor-fit and early-discarded postings as useful market evidence, supports unfamiliar technologies, and prevents hallucinated requirements from becoming database facts or candidate claims.

decision_log.decision: Use a persistent, isolated Chrome CDP profile that the user logs into manually, then permit only explicit JobOS discovery tasks with a small result cap and validated structured JD output.
decision_log.reason: Allows the JobOS browser executor to read a user-authorized LinkedIn session without credential/cookie transfer or any apply/messaging/account-changing behavior.

decision_log.decision: A fresh company-research cache with source URLs is passed to cover-letter generation separately from candidate assets; a paragraph using it must retain known company-source URLs in the evidence map.
decision_log.reason: The letter can be tailored to the company without treating company facts as candidate experience or accepting unsourced company claims.

decision_log.decision: Route every Python chat, generation, and embedding call through services/common/llm_gateway.py. Select Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible token API globally or per role; render OpenClaw agent model choices from OPENCLAW_*_MODEL variables.
decision_log.reason: A machine can use local models, token APIs, or a controlled mix without editing individual service files. API keys remain environment-only and are never included in reports or source control.

decision_log.decision: Treat immigration questions as semantic, user-confirmed decisions; preserve explicit JD/employer evidence separately; disable LLM browser form writes until deterministic origin and control-state verification is complete.
decision_log.reason: A generic sponsorship answer can be legally misleading, and a free-form browser agent cannot prove that it selected the correct field or retained the intended origin.

decision_log.decision: Provide one Ubuntu bootstrap for dependencies, local secrets, PostgreSQL, and migrations; record migration checksums instead of replaying historical SQL.
decision_log.reason: A clean clone must install psycopg automatically, while a database containing applicant data must not be reset by rerunning seed/update migrations.
